findings.description: Dean José R. Sánchez is not in the brief and gets no record. Evidence: the college-wide faculty page (https://www.pnw.edu/college-of-engineering-sciences/faculty/) lists him twice, in the 'College of Engineering and Sciences Leadership' block with the title 'Dean, College of Engineering and Sciences | Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computing Engineering', and again inside the Electrical and Computer Engineering block (before the Mathematics and Statistics heading). His own official profile (https://www.pnw.edu/people/jose-r-sanchez-ph-d/) repeats the same title and does not mention ECE; it lists ECE degrees only. The ECE department page omits him. Ruling: not counted. The title names Electrical Engineering, not ECE, and 'Computing Engineering' is not a unit named elsewhere in the sources. The ECE-block placement is the strongest argument for counting him, but the same page also places him in the leadership block, so it does not clearly state an ECE professorial appointment. Not an omission. What would change this: an official PNW statement that he holds an EE/ECE professorial appointment (for example a department listing or appointment document), which would make him a candidate for a re-audit. Dean is otherwise excluded as academic_professional under the dean rule.

Borderline inclusion. Title is 'Assistant Professor of Computer Engineering' with a Ph.D. in Computer Science, which could suggest CS-only. Counted as regular/ece because he is listed under Faculty on the official ECE department page and his official profile says he joined the ECE department. The profile gives 'Fall 2024' only, so no effective date is recorded. What would change the outcome: an official statement that he is CS-only (cs_only, excluded), which the sources do not give.

The department list shows 'Department Chair, Electrical and Computer Engineering' with no rank. The official profile fills the gap with 'Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering', so the regular professorial rank is established. No change to the outcome.

Enumeration complete. The department faculty-and-staff page (sha256 ab211c43...c50c9, retrieved 2026-11-25T02:11:49Z) lists 8 faculty (chair Tan, lecturer Abdallah, and 6 professors or associate/assistant professors) and 7 emeriti. These are exactly the 15 people in brief.people, matched by name. No omissions. Two staff cards are on the page and were filtered from the brief by title (see next finding).

Staff cards checked and confirmed non-professorial. Honghong Liu: 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Lab Technician' on the department page and on the official profile (https://www.pnw.edu/people/honghong-liu/, retrieved 2026-11-25T02:12:09Z). Karen Norman: 'Administrative Assistant, Electrical and Computer Engineering' on the department page only (no profile fetched); no professorial title appears on any source. Neither is in the brief and neither gets a record.
